title: Fix Job Queue knowledge sample links
summary: Job Queue knowledge articles were corrected to use relative Markdown links for code samples instead of inline code references, restoring the proper format required by the knowledge retrieval system.
key_points: Converted 12 inline code sample references to relative Markdown links across six Job Queue articles
Restored the proper sample.al link format required by Assert-SampleLink validation
Fixed validation errors that were blocking the knowledge index pipeline
Each article updated from inline code to link syntax for .good.al and .bad.al samples
quote: convert the `.good.al` and `.bad.al` references in the six new Job Queue articles from inline code to relative Markdown links
